guide.title: Hebrew and Greek editions for original-language research
guide.intro: Some editions give each word its dictionary form, its grammar or a lexical number. Some are included or offered as verified downloads above; others can be downloaded from their publishers and then chosen here.
guide.note: Check each edition’s licence on its page before sharing anything made from it. If an edition uses the Hebrew Bible’s verse numbers, choose its verse map together with its files (for the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible: wlc/VerseMap.xml).

oshb.name: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (Hebrew Old Testament)
oshb.gives: Written word, lexical number and grammar for every word. No dictionary forms.
oshb.how: Download the repository as a .zip, then choose the .xml files in its wlc folder, including VerseMap.xml. Text: public domain; lexical numbers and grammar: CC BY 4.0.

wlc.name: Westminster Leningrad Codex (Hebrew Old Testament, eBible.org)
wlc.gives: Written word and lexical numbers. Grammar only on a few words.
wlc.how: Download the USFM .zip and choose it together with VerseMap.xml from the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible. Text: public domain; lexical numbers and grammar: CC BY-SA 3.0.

morphgnt.name: MorphGNT: SBL Greek New Testament
morphgnt.gives: Written word, dictionary form and grammar for every word. No lexical numbers.
morphgnt.how: Download the repository as a .zip and choose the .txt files (one per book). Dictionary forms and grammar: CC BY-SA 3.0; the SBLGNT text has its own licence, shown on the page.

rp.name: Robinson–Pierpont Byzantine Greek New Testament (eBible.org)
rp.gives: Written word, lexical number and grammar for every word. No dictionary forms.
rp.how: Download the USFM .zip and choose it. Public domain.

sbl.name: SBL Greek New Testament (eBible.org)
sbl.gives: Written word and lexical numbers only.
sbl.how: Download the USFM .zip and choose it. CC BY 4.0.

concordance.hint: Finds the words as this Bible writes them.
concordance.none: “{{query}}” does not occur in this Bible.
concordance.lemmaHint: Uses this Bible’s own word annotations: the dictionary form (lemma), lexical numbers and grammar codes its edition gives each word. Nothing is looked up elsewhere.
concordance.lemmaUnavailable: This Bible has no word annotations, so it cannot be searched by lemma. Word and phrase search work as before.
concordance.entriesHint: One dictionary form can stand for different words, told apart by their lexical numbers. Choose one.
concordance.noEntry: “{{text}}” is not a lemma or lexical number in this Bible’s annotations.
concordance.grammarDescribed: Described with the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible morphology table; the code is shown as written. Tick codes to see only those words.
concordance.grammarRaw: Grammar codes as this Bible writes them. Abiding Word does not describe this scheme in words. Tick codes to see only those words.
concordance.noneWithGrammar: No occurrences with the chosen grammar.
concordance.numberHint: Uses the lexical numbers this Bible’s edition gives each word (for example Strong’s numbers: H430, G3056). A lexical number points to an entry in a numbered lexicon; it is not a definition, and two Bibles may number the same word differently.

language.hint: Abiding Word uses it to read abbreviations you type (such as “Jn 3:5”) the way this Bible does.

research.title: Original-language research
research.intro: What this edition gives each word, as its own files say. Nothing is looked up elsewhere.
research.grammarStated: Grammar codes are described in words: the edition says it uses {{scheme}} (“{{words}}”, in {{file}}).
research.grammarFit: {{described}} of {{coded}} codes fit this scheme, but the edition does not say it uses it. Leave this unticked to see the codes as written.
research.grammarRaw: Grammar codes are shown as written: their scheme is not one Abiding Word can describe.
research.numbersChoose: Add a search by lexical number
research.numbersHelp: This edition gives lexical numbers (such as Strong’s numbers) but no dictionary forms. A lexical number points to an entry in a numbered lexicon; it is not a definition. Takes about {{size}} MB.
research.numbersLater: You can add or remove it later in Settings → Bible texts.
